propositions: Durable blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural are wrong on disk and distort ready, next-batch, and the parent-first claim cascade since nothing re-resolves them on read.
A store-wide scan re-asks the current resolver what each net-active blocking edge should be, classifying findings as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable.

--repair writes the replacement link before removing the stale one so an interruption leaves a convergeable superset, force-writes a pre-doctor-repair rollback tag, and refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in flight.
run_repair self-deadlocked by holding the non-re-entrant tracker write lock across its loop while each inner event write re-acquired it, burning the 60s timeout; fixed by dropping the outer lock.
On this repository's tracker 18 bad edges were found, 12 repaired and 8 inert residuals remain unrepairable because add_dependency refuses a link whose source ticket is closed.
Re-parenting silently invalidates previously-correct edges, so the check must run periodically rather than as a one-shot cleanup; the standalone verb was rejected and became doctor's first check.
